title: Lekalo context-budget policy
description: Closed contract of one caller-selected mandatory context-budget policy (issue #75). A policy upgrades specific advisory findings of one exactly pinned profile into gate denials: over-budget subjects, reduced required completeness, or baseline regressions with either-bound allowances (deny when either the absolute or the relative bound is exceeded; equality passes; the relative bound skips a zero base). The policy pins the effective-profile digest and id before any metric evaluation, so an advisory-local invocation can never be represented as passing a mandatory QA policy. A denied report still renders in full. Advisory by default: no policy means no denied path. The contract is independent of the product release, of the Model/IR/graph/effect contract versions, and of the diagnostic registry.

mode.description: The closed policy-mode vocabulary; mandatory is the only selectable mode in this generation.

failOn.description: The advisory findings the mandatory gate turns into denials; at least one.

absoluteIncrease.description: The absolute token growth that denies; equality passes.
